welcome_page.title: Access Together usability test
welcome_page.description: Thank you for testing Access Together. Answer after completing the test tasks: it takes about 8 minutes. Every question is optional.

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

sections.title: About you
sections.description: A few questions to describe who took part in the test.

questions.text: Select your age group
Select your gender
Postcode of your municipality
Select your highest level of education

sections.title: Account and profile
sections.description: How easy it was to create and manage your account.

questions.text: How easy is it to create an account?
Are any fields of the sign-up form unclear or confusing?
How easy is it to update your profile?
How easy is it to reset your password?
Any other remarks on these features?

sections.title: Interface
sections.description: How the app looks and what it asks to access.

questions.text: How clear and easy to understand are the texts and icons of the app?
How would you describe the overall layout of the interface?
Do the permissions the app asks for (for example location, activity data, camera) seem reasonable and appropriate?
Any other remarks on these features?

sections.title: Recording trips
sections.description: Recording your trips and reading the results.

questions.text: Does the app support the travel modes or activities you usually use?
How easy is it to record activities with the app?
How easy is it to switch from one travel mode to another during an activity?
Are the results and impact summaries (emissions) useful and easy to understand?
Is the activity history detailed enough for your needs?
Any other remarks on these features?

sections.title: Points and rewards
sections.description: Collecting points and converting them into rewards.

questions.text: Is the number of points given for the distance travelled reasonable?
How easy is it to convert your points into rewards?
Which category of rewards interests you most?
Any other remarks on these features?
How useful would this app be for you?
Would you consider using this app if it were available?

options.text: I would definitely not use it
I would probably not use it

questions.text: Do you have any recommendations to improve this tool?

sections.title: Test tasks
sections.description: Tell us which test tasks you managed to complete.

questions.text: Did you manage to create your account?
Did you manage to update your profile?
Did you manage to reset your password?
Did you manage to complete the questionnaires before and after the activity?
Did you manage to record a trip using at least two different travel modes?
Did you manage to convert the points you collected?
Did you manage to understand all the information in your trip history?

fr.#Postgraduate degree (master or doctorat: Diplôme de deuxième ou troisième cycle (Master ou Doctorat)
fr.#Select your highest level of education: Sélectionnez votre niveau d’études le plus élevé
fr.#<p>A few questions to describe who took: Quelques questions pour décrire les personnes qui ont participé au test.
fr.#How easy is it to create an account?: Dans quelle mesure le processus de création de compte vous semble-t-il facile ?
fr.#Are any fields of the sign-up form uncl: Y a-t-il des champs dans le formulaire d’inscription qui semblent peu clairs ou prêtant à confusion ?
fr.#How easy is it to update your profile?: Dans quelle mesure est-il facile de mettre à jour votre profil ?
fr.#How easy is it to reset your password?: Dans quelle mesure le processus de réinitialisation du mot de passe vous semble-t-il facile ?
fr.#Any other remarks on these features?: Avez-vous d’autres remarques sur ces fonctionnalités ?
fr.#<p>How easy it was to create and manage: Dans quelle mesure il a été facile de créer et de gérer votre compte.
fr.#How clear and easy to understand are th: Dans quelle mesure les textes et les icônes de l’application vous semblent-ils clairs et faciles à comprendre ?
fr.#How would you describe the overall layo: Comment décririez-vous la disposition générale de l’interface ?
fr.#Do the permissions the app asks for (fo: Les autorisations ou accès demandés par l’application (par exemple, localisation, données d’activité, appareil photo) vous semblent-ils raisonnables et appropriés ?
fr.#<p>How the app looks and what it asks t: L’apparence de l’application et les accès qu’elle demande.
fr.#Does the app support the travel modes o: L’application semble-t-elle prendre en charge les modes de mobilité ou d’activité que vous utilisez couramment ?
fr.#How easy is it to record activities wit: Dans quelle mesure semble-t-il facile de suivre les activités à l’aide de l’application ?
fr.#How easy is it to switch from one trave: Dans quelle mesure semble-t-il facile de passer d’un mode de mobilité à un autre pendant l’activité ?
fr.#Are the results and impact summaries (e: Les résultats présentés et les résumés d’impact (émissions) vous semblent-ils utiles et faciles à comprendre ?
fr.#Is the activity history detailed enough: L’historique des activités vous semble-t-il suffisamment détaillé pour répondre à vos besoins ?
fr.#<p>Recording your trips and reading the: L’enregistrement de vos trajets et la lecture des résultats.
fr.#Is the number of points given for the d: Trouvez-vous que le nombre de points attribués en fonction de la distance parcourue est raisonnable ?
fr.#How easy is it to convert your points i: Dans quelle mesure trouvez-vous facile de convertir vos points en cadeaux ?
fr.#Which category of rewards interests you: Quelle catégorie de cadeaux vous intéresse le plus ?
fr.#<p>Collecting points and converting the: La collecte de points et leur conversion en cadeaux.
fr.#How useful would this app be for you?: Dans quelle mesure cette application vous serait-elle utile ?
fr.#Would you consider using this app if it: Envisageriez-vous d’utiliser cette application si elle était disponible ?
fr.#Do you have any recommendations to impr: Avez-vous des recommandations pour améliorer cet outil ?
fr.#Did you manage to create your account?: Avez-vous réussi à créer votre compte ?
fr.#Did you manage to update your profile?: Avez-vous réussi à mettre à jour votre profil ?
fr.#Did you manage to reset your password?: Avez-vous réussi à réinitialiser votre mot de passe ?
fr.#Did you manage to complete the question: Avez-vous réussi à compléter les questionnaires avant et après l’activité ?
fr.#Did you manage to record a trip using a: Avez-vous réussi à enregistrer un trajet en utilisant au moins deux modes de transport différents ?
fr.#Did you manage to convert the points yo: Avez-vous réussi à convertir les points que vous avez collectés ?
fr.#Did you manage to understand all the in: Avez-vous réussi à comprendre toutes les informations présentées dans l’historique de vos trajets ?
fr.#<p>Tell us which test tasks you managed: Indiquez quelles tâches du test vous avez réussi à accomplir.
fr.#<p>Thank you for testing Access Togethe: Merci d’avoir testé Access Together. Répondez après avoir terminé les tâches du test : cela prend environ 8 minutes. Toutes les questions sont facultatives.
fr.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Vos réponses ont été enregistrées. Merci pour votre temps.

it.#Select your highest level of education: Seleziona il tuo titolo di studio più alto
it.#<p>A few questions to describe who took: Alcune domande per descrivere chi ha partecipato al test.
it.#How easy is it to create an account?: Quanto è facile creare un account?
it.#Are any fields of the sign-up form uncl: Ci sono campi del modulo di registrazione poco chiari o che confondono?
it.#How easy is it to update your profile?: Quanto è facile aggiornare il tuo profilo?
it.#How easy is it to reset your password?: Quanto è facile reimpostare la password?
it.#Any other remarks on these features?: Hai altre osservazioni su queste funzioni?
it.#<p>How easy it was to create and manage: Quanto è stato facile creare e gestire il tuo account.
it.#How clear and easy to understand are th: Quanto sono chiari e facili da capire i testi e le icone dell’app?
it.#Do the permissions the app asks for (fo: Le autorizzazioni che l’app chiede (per esempio posizione, dati di attività, fotocamera) ti sembrano ragionevoli e appropriate?
it.#<p>How the app looks and what it asks t: Come appare l’app e a cosa chiede di accedere.
it.#Does the app support the travel modes o: L’app supporta i modi di spostamento o le attività che usi di solito?
it.#How easy is it to record activities wit: Quanto è facile registrare le attività con l’app?
it.#How easy is it to switch from one trave: Quanto è facile passare da un modo di spostamento a un altro durante un’attività?
it.#Are the results and impact summaries (e: I risultati e i riepiloghi d’impatto (emissioni) sono utili e facili da capire?
it.#Is the activity history detailed enough: La cronologia delle attività è abbastanza dettagliata per le tue esigenze?
it.#<p>Recording your trips and reading the: La registrazione dei tuoi viaggi e la lettura dei risultati.
it.#Is the number of points given for the d: Il numero di punti dati in base alla distanza percorsa è ragionevole?
it.#How easy is it to convert your points i: Quanto è facile convertire i tuoi punti in premi?
it.#Bikes and mobility accessories: Bici e accessori per la mobilità
it.#Which category of rewards interests you: Quale categoria di premi ti interessa di più?
it.#<p>Collecting points and converting the: La raccolta dei punti e la loro conversione in premi.
it.#How useful would this app be for you?: Quanto ti sarebbe utile questa app?
it.#Would you consider using this app if it: Useresti questa app se fosse disponibile?
it.#Do you have any recommendations to impr: Hai suggerimenti per migliorare questo strumento?
it.#Did you manage to create your account?: Sei riuscito a creare il tuo account?
it.#Did you manage to update your profile?: Sei riuscito ad aggiornare il tuo profilo?
it.#Did you manage to reset your password?: Sei riuscito a reimpostare la password?
it.#Did you manage to complete the question: Sei riuscito a compilare i questionari prima e dopo l’attività?
it.#Did you manage to record a trip using a: Sei riuscito a registrare un viaggio usando almeno due modi di spostamento diversi?
it.#Did you manage to convert the points yo: Sei riuscito a convertire i punti che hai raccolto?
it.#Did you manage to understand all the in: Sei riuscito a capire tutte le informazioni nella cronologia dei tuoi viaggi?
